sloka: शूलस्य च बलं घोरमप्रमेयं नरर्षभ ।विनाशश्चैव मान्धातुर्यत्तेनाभूच्च पार्थिव ।। ७.६७.२५ ॥
transliteration: śūlasya ca balaṁ ghoramaprameyaṁ nararṣabha ।vināśaścaiva māndhāturyattenābhūcca pārthiva ।। 7.67.25 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, the terrible and immeasurable strength of the trident, and the destruction of Mandhata which was caused by him, has also been recounted, O king.
